instruction: What is the name of the iconic natural swimming pool in the U.S. city that is home to the university of the Texas Longhorns?

provenance.source_benchmark: AssistantBench (Yoran et al., 2024); BrowseComp (Wei et al., 2025)
provenance.construction_method: Chain: Texas Longhorns -> University of Texas at Austin -> Austin -> Barton Springs Pool. Single-value endpoint; the pool needs the city, which needs identifying the team's university.
provenance.difficulty_axis: runtime-dependent chain: each search's result is the input to the next (a plan-upfront workflow cannot chain)

verification.memorization_no_tool: pending (must be non-memorized on the strongest model used)
